The Process

Farm to Family, Every Morning

Four simple steps that bring the purest milk from our partner farms straight to your door before you wake up.

📱
Step 1

Order Online

Place your order via WhatsApp, our website, or subscribe for automatic daily delivery.

🌅
Step 2

Morning Collection

At 5 AM, our farmers collect fresh milk, which is tested, bottled, and loaded for delivery.

🚲
Step 3

Doorstep Delivery

Your fresh glass bottle arrives before 7 AM — before your morning tea is even brewed.

♻️
Step 4

Return & Refresh

Leave your empty bottle outside. We collect it, sanitise it, and fill it again tomorrow.
